## Heading near the break

| Form | Returns | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `rect_mask(X, Y, x0, y0, w, h)` | Matrix same shape as `X` and `Y` | Inclusive on all four sides |
| short | short | short |
| short | short | the last row of a table that should not collide with the heading or the footer |
